title: Cardinal Billing Account Rules Manual: Term Billing and the Installment Schedule
content:
## Section 2. Billing a term on the Cardinal Billing Account

2.1 **Plan.** Each term is billed on the account's pay plan.

2.2 **Down payment (retired clause).** The clause stating that the down payment is installment 1, due on the term effective date, and is the larger of the pay plan's down payment percentage of the full-term premium and the pay plan's minimum down payment, never more than the full-term premium, rounded to the cent, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current down payment basis.

2.3 **Remaining installments.** The remainder is split evenly over the remaining installments, which fall due every installment interval of the pay plan (in months) on the account's installment due day. The number of installments in a term is one plus the result of the package's term months divided by the plan's installment interval, less one. A paid-in-full plan has the down payment only.

2.4 **Rounding.** Any cent left by rounding goes on the last installment.

2.5 **Small installments.** A remaining installment smaller than the pay plan's minimum installment is combined with the one before it.

2.6 **Invoices.** Invoices are issued the pay plan's invoice lead days before each due date.

2.7 **Installment fee (retired clause).** The clause stating that the pay plan's installment fee is added to every installment after the down payment and to no other bill is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current basis for installment charges and additional-premium billing charges.

2.8 **Policy fee.** The policy fee of the auto package is billed once per term with the down payment.

2.9 **Additional premium.** Additional premium is handled by the pay plan's additional premium billing method. Under "spread over the remaining installments" it is divided evenly over the installments of the term not yet billed, and when none remain it is billed at once, due in the pay plan's immediate-bill due days. Under "bill immediately" it is billed at once, due in the pay plan's immediate-bill due days.

2.10 **Return premium.** Return premium is handled by the pay plan's return premium method. Under "reduce the remaining installments" it lowers the installments not yet billed evenly, and any part above what remains unbilled is credited to the balance at once. Under "credit the balance" it is credited all at once.

2.11 **Renewal bill date.** The renewal down payment is billed the pay plan's renewal bill lead days before the term expiration date; that day is the renewal bill date.

## Installment count, illustrated (hypothetical package term lengths)

| Package term | Plan installment interval | Installments in the term |
|---|---|---|
| 6 months | 1 month | one plus (6 divided by 1, less one), that is 6 |
| 6 months | 2 months | one plus (6 divided by 2, less one), that is 3 |
| 6 months | 3 months | one plus (6 divided by 3, less one), that is 2 |
| 12 months | 1 month | one plus (12 divided by 1, less one), that is 12 |

## Return premium above what remains unbilled (hypothetical)

Return premium of $90.00 arrives when $60.00 of the term remains unbilled on a plan that reduces remaining installments. The unbilled installments are lowered evenly by $60.00 in all, and the remaining $30.00 is credited to the balance at once.

superseded_clauses: The down payment is installment 1, due on the term effective date: the larger of down_payment_pct of the full-term premium and min_down_payment_amount, never more than the full-term premium, rounded to the cent.
The installment_fee is added to every installment after the down payment and to no other bill.
